name: echo pumpkin
description: Proposal, October, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x moved left, its hand resting on a pumpkin 14 cells across at its right): it watches and blinks, carves two triangle eyes and a toothy grin left to right with a small ping blade at the end of a forearm drawn out of its arm stub while its eyes narrow, pings its antenna so the spark arcs off the tip over the top and lands on the stem, the lid pops off and the spark has dropped in as the candle flame, the lid falls back on, and the face glows gold and flickers with a warm flicker on the floor while its eyes shut happy; then it pushes the lit pumpkin off the right edge and a fresh plain one drops in where the first stood; judge whether the cuts read as carving at 12 px cells, whether the spark reads as the candle, and whether it is still this creature.
